Learner route

Three steps to focused study.

Choose what you need, see what is published and work at your own pace.

Create learner account Sign in

Create your learner account

Complete the sign-up flow, then sign in to your learner dashboard.

Choose a program

Open ICAO Aviation English or Pilot Licence Theory from Programs.

Study and review

Work through published lessons, practise and track your progress.

If you are in Chile

Learners in Chile can consult DGAC references for PPL, IR, CPL, ME, ATPL and Flight Instructor pathways.

If you are elsewhere

The programs can be used internationally. Country-specific licensing guidance is available only for Chile, so confirm local requirements with your authority.

If you represent a school

Schools can ask about cohort, instructor and resource-management options. We will confirm which tools are ready for your use case.

Not sure where to start?

Send your authority and licence goal. We will point you to the most relevant program.
